name: Alsóörs (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, light grey and red in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsóörs: a red shield with a white church and grapevines above a wavy green base.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
